tool_derived.note: TOOL-DERIVED and machine-checked. Every field here is reproduced from the pinned checkout by `python3 tools/hns-map-data/hns_route.py inventory`, and `hns_route.py inventory --check tools/hns-runtime-probe/evidence/hns-cross-region-inventory.json` fails when this block drifts from that source. The analyzer verifies the checkout revision and the cleanliness of everything it reads before producing any of it.
what_it_can_prove: a warp whose trigger metatile carries a behaviour the engine's warp predicates accept (src/field_control_avatar.c IsWarpMetatileBehavior / TryArrowWarp) is FUNCTIONAL
a `connections` entry with an empty `dest = src - offset` window, or an impassable border column, is DEAD (src/fieldmap.c)
every `warp`/`warpsilent`/`warpteleport` script command whose target is an H&S map in another region, with the exact file and line that contains it
what_it_cannot_prove: whether a warp whose trigger metatile is ordinary floor actually fires: 1719 of this build's 3608 warp tiles sit on non-warp metatiles that the engine still accepts as step-on warps, so map data alone does not settle it. Those edges are reported as `unproven` with the observed metatile behaviour rather than asserted either way

whether a script command is reachable: deciding that needs the script call graph, which weighs 28902 labels in this revision. Script commands are therefore reported as CANDIDATES with their file and line, and `shared_include` marks the ones living in a file that holds more than one map's script set

warp_activation_model.source: src/field_control_avatar.c, the three field-input warp paths

paths.arrow: TryArrowWarp (line 972): the player STANDS on the tile, holds the facing direction, and its metatile satisfies IsArrowWarpMetatileBehavior for that direction. An arrow warp event on ordinary floor never fires.
paths.door: TryDoorWarp (line 1139): the player faces north and the tile IN FRONT carries a warp-door metatile (MB_ANIMATED_DOOR / MB_NON_ANIMATED_DOOR) with a warp event on that front tile.
paths.step: TryStartWarpEventScript (line 1002): the player STEPS ONTO the tile and its metatile satisfies IsWarpMetatileBehavior.

warp_activation_model.common_requirement: all three also need GetWarpEventAtPosition to match, i.e. the warp event's elevation equals the tile's or is ELEVATION_TRANSITION (0)
warp_activation_model.primary_boundary: NUM_METATILES_IN_PRIMARY is 640 for LAYOUT_VERSION_FRLG and LAYOUT_VERSION_HNS (include/fieldmap.h, src/fieldmap.c:GetNumMetatilesInPrimary); only Emerald layouts use 512. Decoding the H&S layouts with 512 mis-resolves every tile in the 512..639 range, which is how an earlier revision of this record mis-read a real arrow warp as ordinary floor.
warp_activation_model.inert_anchors: a warp_def on a tile with none of those behaviours is an inert anchor: many entries in this build exist only as the destination half of a scripted `warp`, and the scripted form calls DoWarp directly without consulting a metatile behaviour.

manual_engine_source_verified.note: MANUALLY ENGINE-SOURCE-VERIFIED. This half is NOT produced by hns_route.py and is not claimed to be. It decides the edges the analyzer reports as undecided from map data, and it records the script-command transitions an analyzer without a call graph cannot resolve. Every verdict carries the exact source that supports it. It is machine-checked in two ways: `hns_route.py inventory --check` fails if any undecided edge has no verdict here or if a verdict contradicts the tool-derived half, and `HnsLocationRuntimeEvidenceTest` asserts the same partition from the Kotlin suite.

evidence: data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/events.inc:18 -- `warp_def 20, 9, 0, 0, MAP_ROUTE22_HNS`: a real warp event naming Route 22

the tile (20,9) carries MB_SOUTH_ARROW_WARP, decoded from data/tilesets/secondary/pokemon_center_white_hns/metatile_attributes.bin through include/global.fieldmap.h (METATILE_ATTR_BEHAVIOR_MASK 0x00FF). TryArrowWarp therefore fires when the player stands there and holds south
tile is walkable (collision 0) and its elevation matches the warp event

data/maps/ReceptionGate_hns/scripts.inc:34-49 -- ReceptionGate_Trigger is the coord event at (11,14) and checks VAR_ECRUTEAK_CITY_THEATER >= 8 plus FLAG_BADGE08_GET, pushing the player back with Common_Movement_WalkDown1 on either failure; (11,14) is a cut vertex joining the arrival corridor to (20,9)
data/maps/Route22_hns/events.inc:21 -- `warp_def 12, 9, 0, 4, MAP_RECEPTION_GATE_HNS`
the tile (12,9) carries MB_ANIMATED_DOOR, which satisfies IsWarpMetatileBehavior, so TryStartWarpEventScript fires when the player steps onto it
data/maps/MtSilver_1F_WaterfallRoom_hns/events.inc:36 -- `warp_def 43, 7, 0, 7, MAP_SNOWSWEPT_CAVERN_HNS`
the tile (43,7) carries MB_NON_ANIMATED_DOOR, which satisfies IsWarpMetatileBehavior

in play it is entered by an NPC scripted warp, not by walking: data/maps/MtSilver_PokemonCenter_hns/scripts.inc:10-44 has Meara require checkitem ITEM_AZURE_FLUTE and then issue `warp MAP_MT_SILVER_1F_WATERFALL_ROOM_HNS, 43, 9`, landing on (43,9) inside a 9-tile pocket that MB_JUMP_SOUTH ledges make one-way. A scripted warp calls DoWarp directly and ignores the warp_def tile, so the warp_def at (43,7) is the outbound half
data/maps/SnowsweptCavern_hns/events.inc:48 -- the reverse `warp_def` at (50,68)
the tile carries MB_SOUTH_ARROW_WARP, so TryArrowWarp fires from it

data/maps/CinnabarIsland_hns/events.inc:22 declares the warp_def, but the trigger tile (41,1) carries MB_OCEAN_WATER: it satisfies none of IsWarpMetatileBehavior, IsArrowWarpMetatileBehavior and the warp-door requirement, so no field-input predicate fires
surfing is not a warp path in this revision -- TryStartWarpEventScript is reached from TryStartStepBasedScript on `tookStep`, and it still requires IsWarpMetatileBehavior
the warp_def is an inert anchor; the Kanto -> Johto whiteout destination is normally reached through a scripted warp or a healing spot

data/maps/FuchsiaCity_hns/events.inc:33 declares the warp_def at (19,30), but the tile carries MB_NORMAL and so does the tile in front at (19,29): the warp-door path needs the tile the player walks INTO to be MB_ANIMATED_DOOR or MB_NON_ANIMATED_DOOR, and the step-on path needs IsWarpMetatileBehavior
collision is 1 on the warp tile, so the player cannot stand on it either

reachability_from_an_early_legal_save.start: the issue #1 progression chain's furthest accepted checkpoint (Azalea Town area, two Johto badges, three party members)
reachability_from_an_early_legal_save.method: flood fill over all 560 H&S maps using the engine's warp and connection predicates (surf/waterfall HM gates read from src/field_move.c IsFieldMoveUnlocked_Surf / _Waterfall), at three assumption levels
evidence: no Surf and no Waterfall: 161 maps reached, ZERO cross-region edges
Surf without Waterfall: 169 maps reached, ZERO cross-region edges
Surf and Waterfall: 342 maps reached, which is where the first cross-region edges appear
Surf is mandatory and needs FLAG_BADGE04_GET: both the New Bark Town east edge (x=29, rows 11-14) and the Route 27 west edge (x=0, rows 22-25) are MB_OCEAN_WATER

Waterfall is mandatory and needs FLAG_BADGE08_GET: Tohjo Falls Cavern's west component joins its centre and east rooms only through the MB_WATERFALL column x=29-34, rows 12-17, and Route 27's east half is reachable no other way
even with Surf and Waterfall, ReceptionGate's (11,14) trigger requires VAR_ECRUTEAK_CITY_THEATER >= 8, set only by TinTower_RoofDay_hns (Ho-Oh) or WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_hns (Lugia)

Fly is not a shortcut: of every sMapHealLocations entry exactly one is cross-region (MAPSEC_ROCKET_HIDEOUT_HNS -> Pallet Town with HEAL_LOCATION_NONE, hence unusable), and every CANFLY city is gated by its own FLAG_VISITED_*, set only by physically entering
neither the tool-derived inventory nor the manual script audit finds any Alola <-> Johto transition
Alola links only to Kanto: MelemeleIsle_hns -> Route13_hns with no gate, and the reverse gated by checkitem ITEM_STRANGE_SOUVENIR, an item sold in the Kanto shop MtMoon_Shop_hns

region_model_correction.note: MAPSEC_VICTORY_ROAD_HNS is REGION_JOHTO, so ReceptionGate_hns, VictoryRoadKanto_1F/B1F/B2F_hns and the whole Kanto Victory Road classify as JOHTO, not Kanto. Likewise MAPSEC_INDIGO_PLATEAU is JOHTO, so Route23_hns does too. That makes the ReceptionGate (20,9) arrow warp the single Johto -> Kanto crossing into the overworld: the actual region change happens on Route 22's east connection into Viridian City.
region_model_correction.consequence: the earlier claim that VictoryRoadKanto_1F_hns -> Route23_hns was a second Johto/Kanto pair is withdrawn; it is a Johto-to-Johto crossing on the way to Indigo Plateau
